sources.author: Loki
patch_list: Replaces MX Player's stripped decoder with the custom codec 1.87.0, so AC3, E-AC3, DTS, DTS-HD, TrueHD and MLP audio play. The codec is downloaded while patching from USBhost's public MX_FFmpeg release and checked against its SHA-256, then…

Routes Google sign-in and Google Drive through MicroG-RE (GmsCore) instead of Google Play services, so MX Player Pro can sign in to Google Drive on a re-signed build. MicroG-RE has to be installed and signed in to a Google account.
MX Player Pro asks Google Play to confirm the purchase and locks itself when the answer is missing, which is always the case for a patched copy. The check is skipped and the app counts as licensed.
